title: Arabic Linguist CAT II
description: Amentum is seeking linguists with excellent English skills to grow our talented and diverse team globally towards our mission’s success. We are looking for dedicated linguist professionals in a variety of languages/dialects to support our intelligence community customer OCONUS. Linguists will support U.S. military operations in Kuwait as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in an assigned area of responsibility. Linguists will contribute an assortment of language services and will be responsible for providing cultural perspective and understanding of the region's historical, political, sociological, and economic trends to select members of the senior leadership staff. Principal Responsibilities: Provide operational contract linguist support for military operations and interpret during interviews, meeting, and conferences. Transcribe and analyze verbal communications. Scan, research, and analyze foreign language documents for key information. Supply a variety of translation and interpretation services for Arabic-Modern Standard. Job Requirements: Must be a U.S. citizen. Must possess excellent command of Arabic-Modern Standard & English verbal skills; Interagency Language Roundtable (ILR) proficiency level 3 in target language and proficiency level 2+ in English based on oral and written language skills examination. Must hold a current U.S. passport. (Or apply as soon as accepted into the program). Must be possess an active Secret clearance for access to classified information. Must be willing to work in Kuwait. Must be willing to work shifts and extended hours in support of 24 x 7 operations. Must have familiarity with and ability to conduct oneself in accordance with the local culture and customs. Must undergo medical examination.

title: Translator / Interpreter
description: JOB OVERVIEW Position: Translator / Interpreter Department: Translation & Interpretation Location: Kathmandu, Nepal Job Type: Full-Time Experience: Minimum 2 Years ABOUT SOLID FUTURE HR CONSULTING PVT. LTD. Solid Future HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is a leading human resource consulting firm in Nepal, providing comprehensive HR solutions to organizations across various industries. With over 10 years of experience in the HR industry, we specialize in Recruitment & Placement, Executive Search & Headhunting, Payroll Management, HR Outsourcing & BPO, Training & Development, and HR Consulting. We are committed to connecting organizations with the right talent through professional recruitment practices and effective human resource solutions. JOB PURPOSE Solid Future HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is recruiting a Translator / Interpreter on behalf of a reputed organization in Kathmandu, Nepal. The selected candidate will be responsible for providing accurate oral and written translation and interpretation services between Arabic, English, and Nepali. The role requires excellent language proficiency, strong communication skills, cultural understanding, and the ability to maintain accuracy, impartiality, professionalism, and confidentiality. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in translation or interpretation, preferably in government, immigration, legal, or other professional settings. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide accurate oral and written translation between Arabic, English, and Nepali. Perform consecutive and simultaneous interpretation during meetings, interviews, and official discussions. Translate documents, reports, correspondence, and other official materials. Ensure accuracy and consistency while maintaining the original meaning and context. Facilitate effective communication between Arabic-speaking and Nepali-speaking individuals. Assist with official, legal, immigration, and administrative communication when required. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and official documents. Ensure impartiality and professionalism during all interpretation assignments. Review and proofread translated documents to ensure linguistic accuracy. Understand cultural differences and language nuances to ensure effective communication. Coordinate with relevant departments and stakeholders to support translation requirements. Maintain proper records of translation and interpretation assignments. Perform other related responsibilities as assigned by management. REQUIRED SKILLS Excellent professional proficiency in Arabic, English, and Nepali. Strong written and verbal communication skills in all three languages. Expertise in translation and interpretation techniques. Ability to accurately translate complex information and official documents. Strong listening, comprehension, and interpersonal skills.
